name: Blank Canvas
source:
The story of Blank Canvas begins with you, a book illustrator who hasn't earned anything in months. The opportunity arises when the writer, Vincent, calls you to inquire about a commission. While you benefit from receiving more than the agreed-upon sum, Vincent imposes a condition: You must complete the project within seven days.

As you strive to complete the commission, you fall into a state of art block. What are you going to do now that the deadline is drawing near?

[From [url=https://tamespiritu.itch.io/blank-canvas]itch.io[/url]]
